notes: Fixes auto-create of missing items: the ItemNonInventoryAdd request was missing its required ItemNonInventoryAddRq wrapper, which made every auto-create call fail with the generic XML parse error. Default window size bumped from 1440x960 to 1600x1040 (with a 1280x800 minimum) so the preview pane is no longer cramped after the new Configuration fields landed. The two missing-SKU fields (Default Income Account and Fallback Item) are now laid out side-by-side instead of stacked.
